name: a-repair-may-not-add-a-finding
find:
key = (finding.code, target.kind, target.key, target.index)
            out[key] = out.get(key, 0) + 1
breaks: the damage gate compares findings as a SET of codes rather than a multiset of (code, target). alt_text_length and alt_text_missing_venue fire once per marker, so a second instance of a code already present is the commonest way a whole body repair gets worse, and a set cannot see it: a repair that pushes another marker over the word band reads as having changed nothing (#1129, L228)
